lines: When death is near and śaktipāta arises, there, in mild cases, by guru
l4.sanskrit_cite: yadā hyāsannamaraṇe śaktipātaḥ prajāyate tatra mande@tha gurvādisevayāyuḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet
